This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking innovative concepts and initiatives.

1. Idea ID
2. Title
3. Description

6. Priority (1-5)
7. Notes

- Update status and notes as progress occurs.
- Review weekly to prioritize action items.", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.txt"}
